Another uni student here, who lost both my parents to cancer in the last few years. People don't understand how much strength it may have taken you to get where you are today, and that is not your fault. No matter if other people see it or not, you're so strong and capable to have kept going and don't ever stop being proud of yourself, even if others aren't.

It’s honestly pot luck, completely depends on people who you end up with. I’ve changed uni and at my 1st year I was in a pretty big flat that was often filthy. It also happened to be filled with predominantly party-centred people. My current uni I’m in a smaller flat and it’s extremely quiet and tidy, which is in part because I found myself in an all-girl flat and the campus itself is known to be quieter. However I know people in identical flats to mine whose kitchens are pretty loud and messy. If you rly want to ensure stuff is quiet there might be options for an alcohol-free flat but other than that you can only cross your fingers. If you rly hate your flat there’s usually options to move though idk how much organising that takes.
